user_request: Build an AI document intelligence platform using AWS. It should allow users to upload PDF documents, extract text using OCR, store documents securely, provide semantic search and question answering using RAG, support user authentication, and expose APIs for integration with other enterprise systems. Prefer reusable open-source solutions where appropriate, but ensure the selected components have suitable licenses and acceptable security/maturity.
normalized_request: An AWS-hosted document intelligence platform enabling PDF upload, OCR-based text extraction, secure storage, semantic search with RAG-based question answering, user authentication, and REST API exposure for enterprise integration.

requirements.description: Users must authenticate securely before accessing the platform
System must accept and store PDF documents securely with access controls
System must extract text from PDF documents using OCR capabilities
System must index extracted text for semantic search and retrieval
System must answer user questions using retrieved document context (RAG pattern)
System must expose REST APIs for third-party enterprise system integration
System must maintain audit logs and security compliance for enterprise requirements
System must provide observability into document processing and query execution

components.name: USER_AUTHENTICATION_AND_AUTHORIZATION
components.description: Manages user identity verification, session management, and access control policies for platform resources and documents

components.name: PDF_UPLOAD_AND_INGESTION_SERVICE
components.description: Accepts PDF file uploads, validates format, manages file staging, and triggers downstream processing workflows

components.name: OCR_AND_TEXT_EXTRACTION_ENGINE
components.description: Extracts text from PDF documents using optical character recognition, handling scanned images and mixed content

components.name: TEXT_PROCESSING_AND_CHUNKING
components.description: Cleans, normalizes, and segments extracted text into optimal chunks for embedding and retrieval

components.name: SEMANTIC_SEARCH_AND_RAG_PIPELINE
components.description: Generates embeddings for text chunks, stores in vector index, retrieves relevant context, and orchestrates LLM-based question answering with retrieved documents

components.name: DOCUMENT_AND_METADATA_STORAGE
components.description: Persists original PDF documents, extracted text, chunk records, embeddings, and associated metadata with encryption and access isolation

components.name: ENTERPRISE_REST_API_GATEWAY
components.description: Exposes documented REST endpoints for document upload, search, question answering, and platform integration with rate limiting and request validation

components.name: AUDIT_LOGGING_AND_COMPLIANCE
components.description: Records user actions, document access, queries, and system events for security audits, compliance reporting, and forensic analysis

components.name: WORKFLOW_ORCHESTRATION_AND_ASYNC_PROCESSING
components.description: Manages asynchronous document processing pipelines, handles retries, and coordinates multi-step operations between OCR, embedding, and indexing services

components.name: MONITORING_AND_OBSERVABILITY_DASHBOARD
components.description: Provides real-time visibility into document processing metrics, query performance, system health, and error tracking

execution_plan.objective: Break down the AI document intelligence platform into discrete technical components: PDF upload/handling, OCR text extraction, secure document storage, semantic search indexing, RAG-based QA, user authentication, and REST API layer, identifying dependencies and data flows between them.

Identify open-source and public ecosystem candidates for each component (OCR engines, vector databases, embedding models, authentication frameworks, document processors, RAG orchestration tools) suitable for AWS deployment, documenting repositories, versions, licenses, and maturity indicators.

Assess each candidate's license compatibility (permissive vs. copyleft), security posture (CVE history, maintenance status), production readiness, AWS integration, scalability constraints, and alignment with enterprise security requirements for document handling.

Determine for each component whether to REUSE an existing open-source solution as-is, ADAPT an existing solution for AWS integration, or BUILD a custom wrapper, providing rationale based on evaluation results and project constraints.

Generate a detailed architecture blueprint specifying selected components, AWS services (S3, Lambda, RDS/DynamoDB, Cognito, API Gateway, etc.), deployment topology, data flow diagrams, integration points, security controls, and implementation sequence.

Validate that the blueprint satisfies all original requirements (PDF upload, OCR, secure storage, semantic search, RAG QA, authentication, APIs), identifies potential gaps, confirms license and security compliance, and highlights assumptions requiring stakeholder approval.
